initial_bank_check.purpose: Original fitting bank residual errors and loss variation; no evaluation truth.

pool_branch_rule.if_memorized: One modest shared public correction pool, defined/reserved before capture and independent of opened evaluation errors; both continuations receive identical pool.
pool_branch_rule.otherwise: Continue on existing B1 bank only.

ownership: Single task owner; separate curator/predictor/scorer processes; no implementation-agent campaign.
preservation: Task-local outputs; no changes to global STATE/registry or other worktrees.
